paper_id: Backward and Forward Language Modeling for Constrained Sentence Generation
title: Backward and Forward Language Modeling for Constrained Sentence Generation
motivation: 现有语言模型无法保证生成文本中必然出现特定词汇
problem_framing: 约束生成:给定词必须出现在生成句子的任意位置
key_insight: 以给定词为根节点生成前后子序列,变单向生成(左→右)为双向生成
method_signature: B/F LM:同步(syn)和异步(asyn)两个RNN变体生成前后词
evaluation_criteria: 困惑度(PPL)和生成文本质量与baseline对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: B/F变体困惑度均高于顺序LM,因随机选split word增加不确定性
evidence_for_taste: All B/F variants yield a larger perplexity than a sequential LM
randomly choosing a split word increases uncertainty
sequential LM fails to generate grammatically correct sentences
sep-B/F can hardly generate a sentence containing much substance
thinking_moves: 将联合概率分解改为贝叶斯网络结构(给定词为根)
从顺序生成sentence重新frame为前后双向生成
承认随机split引入的perplexity代价换取约束保证
实验区分oracle设置下perplexity揭示信息利用能力
